_comment: Half of the native baseline issue #2008 extracts from. Claude Code is
configured to POST its statusline payload to the daemon; the handler
reads rate_limits and nothing else. API-key, Bedrock and Vertex sessions
get no rate_limits block, which the handler records as nothing rather
No credential of Irrlicht's own is involved and nothing is dialled: the
agent hands us the payload inside the permission its adapter already
declares. That is why credential_resolvers is 'none' and
destination_keys is empty, and it is the axis separation #1977 §8 asks
for — a transport axis is not a credential axis.

redaction.note: The statusline payload also carries session_id and transcript_path. Only the rate_limits block is retained, so the committed fixture is that block alone.

fixtures.name: statusline-rate-limits
fixtures.note: The rate_limits block, in the wire shape statusline.go documents and statusline_test.go exercises. A shape fixture, not a capture: grepping replaydata/ for five_hour returns no statusline payload. The one committed claudecode capture that mentions five_hour is the 1858-usage-limit-stuck-in-error regression transcript, and it carries a quotaLimits REJECTION object (rateLimitType/resetsAt on a 429), which is a different shape on a different route and is not what this handler reads.

billing_mode.note: The handler reads only rate_limits, and no full statusline payload is committed here, so whether this route reports the plan or product has not been looked at. Not a negative finding — nothing looked.

quota_windows.note: five_hour maps to a 300-minute window and seven_day to 10080, each with an absolute reset. fixture-verified rather than live-verified: this repository holds no dated capture of a real statusline response, and #1977 §11.11 forbids claiming live verification from a fixture alone.

balance.note: The statusline payload has no credits or balance block.

account_identity.note: RateLimitSnapshot.ConfirmedAccountRef has no producer on this route.

evidence.note: The documented wire shape and the window mapping.
